description: This file contains shell functions and setup scripts for configuring Virtual Tunnel Interface (VTI) and VTI6 on OpenWRT, including initialization, setup, teardown, and dependency management.

methods.name: vti_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up a generic VTI tunnel with provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: vti_setup
methods.description: Configures a VTI interface with actual IP addresses and dependencies.

methods.name: proto_vti_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function that sets up VTI with specific mode 'vtiip'.

methods.name: vti6_setup
methods.description: Configures a VTI6 interface with actual IPv6 addresses and dependencies.

methods.name: proto_vti6_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function that sets up VTI6 with specific mode 'vtiip6'.

methods.name: proto_vti_teardown
methods.description: Teardown function placeholder for VTI interface.

methods.name: proto_vti6_teardown
methods.description: Teardown function placeholder for VTI6 interface.

methods.name: vti_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for VTI interfaces.

methods.name: proto_vti_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options specific to VTI.

methods.name: proto_vti6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options specific to VTI6.
